notes.title: V 1.3.0 - Quality of Life & Polish
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830192/a44bd4483bf5c964225d3b2ed1a6adca8ed26d4b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]✨ New Features & Improvements[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🌩️ Steam Cloud Support[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Your saves now sync automatically across devices![/p][quote][p]⚙️ [b]Important:[/b]
If you play on multiple devices, [b][u]load your main save first[/u][/b] to avoid overwriting progress.[i]Prefer separate saves?[/i] Disable Steam Cloud for this game in your Steam settings.[/p][/quote][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🧙‍♂️ Lore-Friendly Naming Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]All creature names have been unified under a [b]"Latin-rooted + Lovecraftian aesthetic"[/b] style.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🖊️ Pet Renaming[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Found in the [b]entity details panel[/b]—you can now give your tamed companions [b]custom names![/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🐞 Minor Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Squashed bugs, optimized a few things, fixed typos.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🎨 Visual Updates[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🐢[/b] [b]"Turtle" Redesign[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The old sprite was created in the early stages of development, when creatures were intended to look very similar to real animals. The turtle’s excessive realism no longer matched the game’s current visual style, so the design has been reimagined to look more fantastical.[/p][p][/p][p]OLD[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830192/43c070125140327bb3485add187afe60dd36ab58.png"][/img][/p][p]NEW[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830192/17565a61b6b3447e3ffef58be689e6573196d951.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🐛🔥[/b] [b]"Fire Beetle" Redesign[/b][/h3][list][*][p]This was one of the very first sprites, made back when we were still exploring the game’s visual style. For a long time we kept it as a small piece of the game’s history, but eventually it felt too plain and out of place in the current design, so it has now been given a fresh new look.[/p][p][/p][p]OLD[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830192/1326ad6f819a129884587192606a73d3fe4e61ad.png"][/img][/p][p]NEW[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830192/3070547aaeb15780f8efc33b5b42c1e3d63ef241.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🔜 Coming Soon...
[/b][/h2][p][b]"Distorted Specimens"[/b] – Rare, uniquely colored creatures with special stat bonuses! [i](Prepare for the hunt...)[/i][/p]

notes.title: V 1.2.5 - "Collectors and hardcore players"
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830192/a44bd4483bf5c964225d3b2ed1a6adca8ed26d4b.png"][/img][/p][h2]🚪 [b]Scroll Storage Expansion[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Scroll storage now has [b]90 slots by default![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]No upgrades required[/b] to unlock space — all slots are available immediately![/p][/*][*][p]Collectors can now [b]catch every entity in the game![/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]🔧 [b]New Storage Upgrade Bonuses[/b][/h2][p]Since the old storage upgrade system no longer makes sense, here’s what you get now:[/p][list][*][p]📦 [b]Upgrade Level 1:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increases starting "Luck's Wind" (a bit stronger than before)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]💰 [b]Upgrade Level 3:[/b][/p][list][*][p]+7% gold from all sources[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🗝️ [b]Upgrade Level 5:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increases the chance of finding chests[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Other upgrade levels remain unchanged.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]⚙️ Optimization[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Improved FPS performance, especially when the inventory is open.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]⚖️ [b]Balance Changes[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Ethereal trait:[/b][/p][p]OLD: [b]This entity's Defense is ignored. Always reduces Physical damage taken by 30%, but takes 20% more Magic damage[/b][/p][p]NEW: [b]This entity's Defense is ignored. Always reduces Physical damage taken by 30%, but takes 15% more Magic damage[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Necronomicon item:[/b][/p][p]OLD: [b]When attacking a target with the “Fear” effect, ignores half of all defense and converts 5% of dealt damage into Energy.[/b][/p][p]NEW: [b]When attacking a target with the “Fear” effect, ignores half of all defense and converts 5% of dealt damage into Energy. The “Ethereal” trait doesn’t increase incoming magic damage.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]🏆 [b]New Achievement[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Defeat the final boss [b]without losing a single entity![/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]💬 [b]Community Help[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Since English isn’t my first language, I sometimes have trouble finding the perfect names for entities. They sound okay to me, but based on feedback from native speakers, maybe they don’t always land as well as I thought. 😊[/p][p]So I would love to ask for your help:
If you think some entity names sound weird or don’t fit well — please leave a comment under this post.
It would be amazing if you could suggest your own name ideas too![/p][p]Thank you so much for your support and for helping to make the game better ❤️[/p]

notes.title: V 1.2.0 - Rebalance
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830192/a44bd4483bf5c964225d3b2ed1a6adca8ed26d4b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Today's update is the [b]first step in the evolution of Voidsayer[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The original idea and philosophy:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Voidsayer was always meant to be a modern interpretation of [b]classic[/b] monster-taming games, carefully preserving the core of the genre and the familiar battle system. Of course, it was clear from the beginning that in 2025, a purely classic combat system would probably feel a bit "flat and simple", so I introduced some innovations: attributes, a status effect system, and passive abilities. Still, the goal was to [b]stay within the genre’s boundaries[/b].[/p][p]Based on your feedback, though, it seems that the [b]combat system could use a bit more depth[/b]. It’s very important for me to keep the heart and spirit of classic monster-taming games, but I also want to respect your desire for more strategy and build variety.[/p][p]Starting with this update, I will gradually [b]deepen both the combat and build systems[/b] until I find that perfect balance — where battles are exciting and tactical, but the game still feels like a true monster-taming experience.[/p][p][/p][quote][p]⚙️ [b]Important:[/b]
Your current saves will continue to work. There's no need to start a new game. However, the changes are significant, so I would recommend either starting over or carefully reviewing your team and equipment.[/p][/quote][p][/p][p][b]Now, let’s move on to the list of changes (and there’s a lot)![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Key Changes:[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Entities no longer have types.[/b]
Only abilities retain types now. This simplifies the system and removes unnecessary confusion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Passive abilities have been completely removed from the game.[/b]
They had too little impact on gameplay: most of them provided minor stat boosts or luck-based effects that were often not relevant. In most cases, they could simply be ignored.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Introducing "Traits" as a replacement for types and passive abilities.[/b] Traits are a new core system that combines the essence of both types and passives. Each trait provides a unique effect that genuinely changes playstyle, tactics, and interactions with enemies and equipment:[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛡️ [b]Absorption[/b][/h3][p]Ignores stat reduction from effects (Except Wild)[/p][h3]🌱 [b]Plant[/b][/h3][p]Immune to the Poison effect[/p][p]Converts 20% of damage dealt into Energy if attacking a target with the Poison effect[/p][p]Takes 25% more damage from Fire attacks[/p][p]Takes 15% less damage from Water, Flora, Ground attacks[/p][h3]🔥 [b]Burning[/b][/h3][p]Immune to the Burn effect[/p][p]15% chance to inflict Burn for 2 rounds when receiving Physical damage[/p][p]Takes 20% more damage from Water, Medium attacks[/p][p]Takes 25% less damage from Fire, Flora attacks[/p][h3]💚 [b]Will to Live[/b][/h3][p]Immune to the Desire to Surrender effect[/p][p]Physical and Magic Defense +20 when Energy < 30%[/p][h3]🗿[b]Rock[/b][/h3][p]Immune to Shock, Daze[/p][p]Takes 30% more damage from Water, Flora, Medium attacks[/p][p]Takes 25% less damage from Normal, Fire, Ground, Electricity attacks[/p][p]-25% damage taken from critical hits[/p][h3]🌊 [b]Dweller of the Depths[/b][/h3][p]Takes 25% more damage from Electricity attacks[/p][p]Takes 20% less damage from Water, Fire attacks[/p][p]+10 Resistance for each active temporary effect[/p][h3]⚡ [b]Charged[/b][/h3][p]Immune to the Shock effect[/p][p]5% chance to inflict Shock for 1 round when receiving Physical damage[/p][p]Takes 20% more damage from Ground attacks[/p][p]Takes 20% less damage from Electricity attacks[/p][h3]🛡️ [b]Shell[/b][/h3][p]Inflicts Extraction for 1 round if End of Round Energy < 25%[/p][h3]🍷 [b]Drain[/b][/h3][p]Converts 10% of damage dealt into Energy when attacking a target with higher Energy reserve[/p][p](Does not work if the target has the trait Undead Eye or Ethereal)[/p][h3]☠️ [b]Undead[/b][/h3][p]Immune to effects Poison, Fear, Madness[/p][p]15% chance per fallen ally to deal 25% more damage[/p][p]Takes 25% more damage from Fire, Medium attacks[/p][p]Takes 20% less damage from Ghost, Djinn attacks[/p][h3]👁️ [b]Greed[/b][/h3][p]30% chance to inflict Anger for 2 rounds if the opponent applies an effect to themselves after attacking[/p][p]If any gem is equipped, Physical and Magic defense +5,[/p][p]otherwise ignores all stat changes from any equipment[/p][h3]🎭 [b]Illusionist[/b][/h3][p]Inflicts Mirage for 1 round if it receives a critical attack[/p][h3]🧞 [b]Djinn[/b][/h3][p]Immune to effect Mirage[/p][p]Deals 15% more damage with attacks of type Djinn if no weapon is equipped[/p][p]Takes 20% more damage from Medium attacks[/p][p]Takes 15% less damage from Ghost, Djinn attacks[/p][h3]🌌 [b]Ethereal[/b][/h3][p]This entity's Defense is ignored[/p][p]Always reduces Physical damage taken by 30%, but takes 20% more Magic damage[/p][h3]🔥 [b]Berserker[/b][/h3][p]Inflicts Anger for 1 round if End of Round Energy < 20%[/p][p](Doesn't work if any weapon is equipped)[/p][h3]👑 [b]Dominant[/b][/h3][p]Deals 15% more damage to the target if its total Physical and Magical defense is lower than this entity's[/p][h3]⚔️ [b]Combat Ready[/b][/h3][p]Physical and Magic Attack +15% when Energy is >75%[/p][h3]🧘 [b]Inner Peace[/b][/h3][p]Immune to the effect Madness[/p][p]Takes 20% more damage from Djinn attacks[/p][p]Takes 20% less damage from Ghost, Medium attacks[/p][h3]☠️ [b]Avenger[/b][/h3][p]Non-critical attacks deal 15% more damage if this is the last undefeated entity in the team[/p][h3]🐺 [b]Beast[/b][/h3][p]Deals 10% more damage to the target if faster than them[/p][p]Receives 20% more damage from attacks of type Ghost[/p][h3]🛡️ [b]Parry[/b][/h3][p]Inflicts Defensive Stance for 2 rounds if dodged[/p][h3]🐜 [b]Insect[/b][/h3][p]Deals 15% more damage to targets with lower Resistance[/p][p]Deals 15% more damage to targets with the trait Plant, restores 5% of max Energy when finishing them with an attack[/p][p]Takes 20% more damage from Fire attacks[/p][p]Takes 15% less damage from Ghost, Djinn, Medium attacks[/p][h3]🌀 [b]Adaptive[/b][/h3][p]Applies Crystal Skin for 1 round if at the end of the round the total of Physical and Magic attack is less than the opponent's[/p][h3]❌ [b]Outcast[/b][/h3][p]Takes 15% less damage from enemies that share at least one trait[/p][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The concept of effective and ineffective attacks has been completely removed from the game. In the new system, this mechanic no longer makes sense since the classic type advantage no longer exists.[/p][/*][*][p]The UI no longer highlights effective or ineffective attacks because the concept of “attack effectiveness” is no longer relevant.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies will no longer swap their entities just because they believe their current choice is "weak by type" while having a "better option" in reserve. There are no universal advantages anymore — battles now depend entirely on selecting the right tactics against the enemy's traits.[/p][/*][*][p]All entities have been given new sets of traits, and their stats have been reworked. These changes affect every entity, so I won’t list them all individually here.[/p][/*][*][p]Most equipment has been significantly reworked:[/p][/*][/list][p]👑 [b]Sharp Leaf Crown[/b]
Critical attack chance +6
Unable to apply Desire to Surrender effect
Critical attacks deal bonus damage equal to 5% of the target's maximum Energy[/p][p]❤️‍🔥 [b]Volcano Heart[/b]
Grants the trait Burning
Enemy takes 50% more damage from the Burn effect[/p][p]💚 [b]Emerald[/b]
Grants the trait Plant
Resistance +15
Physical and Magic defense is increased by one-third of the [b]base[/b] Resistance[/p][p]💎 [b]Diamond[/b]
Grants the trait Rock
Physical defense +8
Unable to apply the Vulnerability effect[/p][p]📖 [b]Necronomicon[/b]
When attacking a target with the Fear effect, ignores half of all defense
Converts 5% of dealt damage into Energy[/p][p]👁️ [b]Prophet's Eye[/b]
Accuracy +8
Unable to apply the Mirage effect[/p][p]⚫ [b]Magnetite[/b]
Grants the trait Absorption
Magic defense and Resistance +5[/p][p]⚔️ [b]Training Sword[/b]
Physical attack +4%
Normal type abilities deal 8% more damage[/p][p]🛡️ [b]Training Shield[/b]
Physical and Magic Defense +5
Receives 20% less damage from Normal type abilities[/p][p]🦚 [b]Harpy Feather[/b]
Speed +2, Evasion +3
Ignores Speed and Evasion reduction from effects and equipment[/p][p]👊 [b]Brass knuckles[/b]
Critical attack power +0.2
3% chance to inflict Daze for 1 round when dealing physical damage[/p][p]🥋 [b]Ninja Belt[/b]
Ignores half of the opponent's Accuracy
Dodge +4[/p][p]⚜️ [b]Paladin's Chestplate[/b]
Physical and Magic defense +7
Ignores defense reduction from effects
Reduces incoming damage by 15% from Djinn, Ghost attacks[/p][p]🏰 [b]Tower Shield[/b]
Physical and Magic defense +15
Evasion, Speed -3[/p][p]🗡️ [b]Excalibur[/b]
Physical and Magical Attack +10%
Deals 15% more damage to targets with the Undead trait
10% chance to apply Blindness for 2 rounds when dealing both Physical and Magical damage with one attack[/p][p]⚔️ [b]Broken Sword[/b]
Physical and Magic attack +10%, Evasion and Speed -2
(Evasion and Speed are not reduced if the bearer has the Berserker trait)[/p][p]☥ [b]Ankh Amulet[/b]
Resistance, Physical and Magical Defense +5
Bonus doubles if the wearer has the Undead or Djinn trait[/p][p]🗡️ [b]Jack's Katana[/b]

Critical attack chance +5
Critical attack power +0.1[/p][p]🔍 [b]Magnifying Glass[/b]

Speed -2[/p][p]👟 [b]Tabi[/b]

Evasion +3[/p][p]💨 [b]Smoke bomb[/b]

3% chance to inflict Mirage for 1 turn when dealing Magic damage[/p][p]🧙‍♀️ [b]Elder Wand[/b]

Converts 5% of Magic damage dealt into Energy[/p][p]🐉 [b]Haku Horn[/b]

Influence of Character and Genetics on Evasion +50%[/p][p]🛡️ [b]Steel plate[/b]

(Chance increases to 40% if the bearer has trait Rock)[/p][p]🌋 [b]Magma Stone[/b]

+13% to the damage type with the lowest base value

The bonus increases to 15% if the bearer does not have the trait Inner Peace[/p][p]🧤 [b]Leather gloves[/b]

(+3 if you have more than [b]300[/b] coins)[/p][p]👻 [b]Ectoplasm[/b]

Restores 8% of maximum Energy[/p][p]😈 [b]Mask of Madness[/b]

Restores 4% of the maximum Energy pool on a crit[/p][p]🧪 [b]T-Virus[/b]

Magic Defense +5[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Changes in Item Acquisition:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Steel Plate[/b] now drops from [b]Golden Chests[/b] (previously dropped from Mimics).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoke Bomb[/b] now drops from [b]Mimics[/b] (previously dropped from Golden Chests).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Motivation:[/b]
The Steel Plate is required for certain evolutions, and getting it from Mimics was too difficult and unreliable.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Changes to Alternative Event Outcomes[/h2][p][/p][p][i](These changes only affect events whose alternative outcomes previously depended on types or passive abilities)[/i][/p][list][*][p]To [b]intimidate the robber[/b], you now need an entity with the [b]Berserk[/b] or [b]Dominant[/b] trait.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Magic Trap[/b] event, the alternative outcome has been completely removed (but the event itself now deals slightly less damage).[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Road to Nowhere[/b] event, the alternative outcome now requires an entity with the [b]Illusionist[/b] trait.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Storm[/b] event, the alternative outcome now requires an entity with the [b]Charged[/b] trait.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Thorn Vine[/b] event, the fire-based alternative outcome has been removed. For the flora-based outcome, you now need an entity with the [b]Plant[/b] trait.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Berry Bush[/b] event, the alternative outcome now requires an entity with the [b]Absorption[/b] trait.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Bastet[/b] event, the alternative outcome now requires an entity with the [b]Beast[/b] trait.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Box[/b] event, the alternative outcome now requires an entity with the [b]Stone[/b] trait.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Blackleaf[/b] event, the alternative outcome has been completely removed.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Nightmare[/b] event, the alternative outcome now requires an entity with the [b]Inner Peace[/b] trait.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Clentaminato[/b] event, the alternative outcome now requires an entity with the [b]Burning[/b] trait.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Bone Hand[/b] event, the alternative outcome now requires an entity with the [b]Berserk[/b] trait.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Dark Thought[/b] event, the alternative outcome now requires an entity with the [b]Will to Live[/b] trait and [b]a 50% chance of success[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Updated Entity Capture System:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]All [b]capture scrolls are now twice as effective.[/b] However, you can now [b]use only one scroll per battle.[/b][/p][quote][p]Overall, the system remains balanced, but now [b]maximum capture chances require just one turn instead of two.[/b][/p][/quote][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Scroll prices have doubled[/b], and [b]the chance to find scrolls has been halved.[/b][/p][quote][p]Since scrolls are twice as effective, their average availability remains about the same.[/p][/quote][/*][*][p]The [b]debuff applied to wild entities after using a scroll has been slightly strengthened[/b], making captures [b]less resource-intensive.[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Early game difficulty has been slightly reduced:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Starting entities now begin at [b]Level 5[/b] (previously Level 4).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Assembling a team is now easier in the early game[/b] thanks to the new capture system.[/p][/*][*][p]Players now receive [b]more effective scrolls at the beginning.[/b][/p][quote][p](Technically, the number of starting scrolls is still 4, but they are now twice as effective.)[/p][/quote][/*][*][p]Thanks to the new [b]trait system[/b], starting entities are [b]slightly stronger in the early game[/b], but due to reduced stat growth, their late-game power remains balanced.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early game equipment[/b] is now slightly more effective.[/p][/*][*][p]Players now receive [b]slightly more gold[/b] for completing the first levels.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Increased Late-Game Difficulty:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Entities [b]controlled by trainers now choose attacks more intelligently.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Trainers [b]more frequently have entities equipped with two items.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bosses are now significantly stronger[/b], especially in later stages:[/p][quote][p]their equipment and teams have been notably enhanced.[/p][/quote][/*][*][p]Some levels [b]after the second boss have been made more challenging.[/b][/p][quote][p]Several [b]endgame levels[/b] have become significantly harder.[/p][/quote][/*][*][p][b]The fourth Abyssal Constraint has been strengthened:[/b] it now reduces [b]15% of maximum health[/b] (previously 10%).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Fixes and improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Game now automatically mutes when minimized.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted names for certain entities.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed map events that revealed unexplored areas breaking the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected various translation errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Soul Extractors and Gene Modifiers are no longer removed after a run.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle interface now displays the type of selected attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed 2 stages on the path to Boss 4 (streamlined pacing; remaining stages are harder with redistributed rewards).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual issues for several entities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]"Unicorn -> Earthshaker[/b]" evolution now requires Equipment "Fenrir Fur"[/p][/*][*][p]Updated skill sets for certain entities (e.g., removed redundant defense skills from transparent entities).[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked appearance rates for "neutral" random events.[/p][/*][*][p]Entities now clear their fatigue when replaced.
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Upcoming Plans for the Next Patch:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Innate Talent System[/b][/p][quote][p]With a very rare chance, entities can spawn with the "Innate Talent" trait, which allows their stats to grow faster than others of the same species.[/p][/quote][/*][*][p][b]Ability Purchase System[/b][/p][quote][p]Currently in development: either players will be able to swap specific abilities for their variants, or each entity will have the option to switch between [b]two attack sets[/b], effectively creating a [b]battle style switch[/b].[/p][/quote][/*][*][p][b]Ability to Rename Entities[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Effect  and Ability Remaster[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Aspect System Remaster[/b][/p][quote][p]Especially moving all "skip turn" effects into dedicated aspects to ensure their activation chances become "clean" and more predictable.[/p][/quote][/*][*][p][b]Soul Storage Expansion[/b][/p][quote][p]Increasing minimum capacity to 12 slots, possibly tripling its current size.[/p][/quote][/*][*][p][b]More Achievements[/b], especially challenging and unique ones.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Evolution Animation[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Remaster of Some Outdated or Odd Sound Effects[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Advanced Difficulty Settings[/b][/p][quote][p]This will not be a simple easy/hard toggle but a [b]modular checkbox system[/b] allowing players to enable or disable specific gameplay features:[/p][/quote][list][*][p]empowered bosses[/p][/*][*][p]simplified early game[/p][/*][*][p]permadeath mode[/p][/*][*][p]and more.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: V1.1.0 - A couple of improvements
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830192/a44bd4483bf5c964225d3b2ed1a6adca8ed26d4b.png"][/img][/p][p]Version 1.1.0 - Major Changes:[/p][p][/p][p]\[Gameplay][/p][p][/p][p]- Removed pausing when game is minimized[/p][p][/p][p]\[Fixes][/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed spawn rates for certain entities to match intended values[/p][p][/p][p]- Corrected onyx classification (now properly recognized as gemstone)[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed some localization errors in UI texts[/p][p][/p][p]\[Balance][/p][p][/p][p]- Complete blessings system rebalance[/p][p][/p][p]- Slight buffs to certain equipment items[/p][p][/p][p]- Increased chance of positive outcome for "Rumors" event[/p][p][/p][p]- "Look Around" action now yields 50% less gold on completed levels[/p][p][/p][p]- Improved item drop rates from random events in late game (the further you progress, the higher chance for rare items)[/p][p][/p][p]- Boss equipment adjusted to passive ability rebalance (see below)[/p][p][/p][p]- Complete rework of passive ability "Outcast" => Takes 20% less damage from enemies that share at least one type[/p][p][/p][p]- Complete rework of passive ability "Merge" (now called "Drain") => 7% of damage dealt is converted into Energy if attacking a target with higher Energy than the attacker[/p][p][/p][p]- Complete rework of passive ability "Envy" (now called "Greed") => 30% chance to inflict "Anger" for 2 turns if opponent applies self-buff after attacking. If any gem is equipped: Physical and Magic defense +5, otherwise ignores all stat changes from equipment[/p]

notes.title: Launch Day Hotfixes V2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830192/e73df2e5ba28b4eccf48ec1793a5a3a9f9ab0804.png[/img]

A few more small changes based on player feedback:

- Fixed a bug where the story could get stuck on early quests

- Slightly increased the level cap (now players who are stuck can grind a bit more if needed)

- "Muzzle" item has been doubled in strength (this should make it easier to handle wild Entities in the early stages of the game)

notes.title: Launch Day Hotfixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830192/e73df2e5ba28b4eccf48ec1793a5a3a9f9ab0804.png[/img]

Some changes based on early feedback:

- Fixed a bug where available levels would disappear from the map after completing Pink Peak.

- Earning gold is now a bit easier: golden paths are more rewarding, and during long rests you can once again "look around," even if the level has already been completed.

notes.title: The Abyss Approaches
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=uOKpg5hamSE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The world is on the brink of destruction![/b] It’s time for a true hero to rise and defend the future of humanity.

🎮 [b]Voidsayer [/b]is a turn-based strategy [b]RPG [/b]focused on building the perfect squad of monsters. Familiar and beloved mechanics are reimagined to deliver a dark and unforgettable experience.

💀 This game won’t go easy on you — its goal is to [b]break the player[/b]. After a short introduction, it starts pressing… and won’t let go. There are no ups and downs here — only the abyss. This is a story about taking the hit and pushing through hopelessness.

⚔️ [b]Every battle matters.[/b] Tactical mastery, tight resource control, and smart min-maxing are your only path to survival. There are no weak monsters or useless items — it’s all about your approach. There’s no “legendary weapon” that wins the game on its own. Even a stick can become a legend… if you know how to use it.

[b]Launching June 2nd![/b]
🛒 Add [b]Voidsayer [/b]to your [b]wishlist [/b]if you haven’t already — and get ready to suffer… [i]in style.[/i]
